people.generalInfoHtml: Akhmetzhanov Marat Muratovich, born in 1964, has a higher education, graduated from Karaganda State University with a degree in jurisprudence.
people.careerHistoryHtml:
He began his career in 1991 as an intern at the prosecutor's office of the city of Temirtau. In 1993-1996 - Senior Investigator for Particularly Important Cases of the Special Prosecutor's Office for Combating Corruption under the General Prosecutor's Office of the Republic of Kazakhstan, then Head of the Department of Regional Investigators of the Department for the Investigation of Especially Dangerous Crimes of the General Prosecutor's Office of the Republic of Kazakhstan. In 1996-1997, he was the head of the Department for Investigation of Especially Dangerous Crimes, then the head of the Investigation Department of the Military Investigation Department of the State Investigative Committee. In 1997-1998 - Head of the Investigation Department of the Military Investigation Department of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan. In 1998-2001 - Deputy Director of the Department of Investigations, then Deputy Chairman of the Committee for the Execution of Court Orders of the Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Kazakhstan. In 2001-2003 - Head of the Department for Supervision of Legality in the Investigation and Inquiry Bodies of the General Prosecutor's Office of the Republic of Kazakhstan. In 2003-2006 - the prosecutor of Pavlodar region. In 2006-2009 - the prosecutor of the South Kazakhstan region. In 2009-2012 - Chairman of the Committee on Legal Statistics and Special Accounts of the General Prosecutor's Office of the Republic of Kazakhstan. In 2012-2014 - Deputy Chairman of the Agency of the Republic of Kazakhstan for combating economic and corruption crimes. In 2014-2016 - Head of the Department for Civil Service Affairs and Anti-Corruption of the Atyrau Region, then Head of the Department of the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Atyrau Region.

In 2016-2021 - Deputy Prosecutor General of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

In 2021-2022 - Chairman of the Anti-Corruption Agency of the Republic of Kazakhstan (Anti-Corruption Service).

In 2022-2023 - Minister of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

Since September 2023, he has been the Akim of the Akmola region.

Awarded with the Orders "Kurmet", "Danq" of the 2nd degree, "Danq" of the 1st degree, IPA CIS "Commonwealth".

Akim of the region

Management of the activities of the regional akimat and the regional akim's office.

Coordination of the work of the first deputy, deputy akims of the region, the head of the regional akim's office, regional executive bodies, akims of districts, the cities of Kokshetau, Kosshy and Stepnogorsk, coordinated functioning of all territorial divisions of the central state bodies of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

Strategic issues of economic, financial, fiscal policy, local budget.

Personnel policy issues.

Defense and law and order issues.

Issues of rule-making activities.

In practical activities, the regional akim may delegate some of the powers to the first deputy, deputy akims of the region, the head of the regional akim's office and akims of districts, the cities of Kokshetau, Kosshy and Stepnogorsk.

In the absence of the regional akim, he is replaced by the first deputy akim of the region, in the absence of the first deputy akim of the region - one of the deputy akims of the region.

Represents the regional akimat in relations:

Аt the republican level: with the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Prime Minister of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Administration of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Government Office of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Parliament of the Republic of Kazakhstan, ministries and other central government bodies;

Аt the regional level: with law enforcement and special government bodies, territorial departments of central government bodies, local executive and representative bodies, quasi-public sector organizations and other organizations.

Heads: the regional akimat, the regional budget commission, the council for attracting investors and improving the investment climate, the regional coordinating council, the regional coordinating council for the implementation of investment projects, the regional export council, the expert council on entrepreneurship, the council on youth affairs, the commission for determining the winners of the National Competition "Mereili otbasy", the commission for placing a state educational order for training personnel with higher and postgraduate education, the commission for awarding educational grants to pay for higher and postgraduate education, the regional commission for the prevention and elimination of emergency situations, the commission for state symbols, the commission for combating corruption, the commission for the prevention of offenses, the anti-terrorist commission, the commission for the appointment of the personal scholarship of the akim of the region, the personnel commission of the region, the commission for reviewing submissions for awarding the Honorary Certificate of the akim of the region.

Accountable structural divisions of the regional akim’s office and positions: division for the protection of state secrets, press service of the regional akim, internal audit service, assistant to the regional akim for regime, assistant to the regional akim for military security and defense.

该州州长
管理地区行政长官和地区行政长官办公室的活动。
协调第一副州长、副州长、州长办公室主任、州级执行机构、各区区长以及科克舍套市、科希市和斯捷普诺戈尔斯克市市长的工作，并协调哈萨克斯坦共和国中央国家机关各驻地机构的运行。
经济、金融、财政政策、地方预算的战略问题。
人事政策问题。
国防和法律与秩序问题。
规则制定活动的问题。
在实际活动中，地区长官可将部分权力委托给地区第一副长官、副长官、地区长官办公室主任以及区长、科克舍套市、科希市和斯捷普诺戈尔斯克市的长官。
如果地区长缺席，则由该地区第一副市长接替；如果该地区第一副市长缺席，则由该地区副市长之一接替。

共和国一级：哈萨克斯坦共和国总统、哈萨克斯坦共和国总理、哈萨克斯坦共和国总统办公厅、哈萨克斯坦共和国政府办公厅、哈萨克斯坦共和国议会、各部委和其他中央政府机构；
地区一级：执法机构和特别政府机构、中央政府机构的领土部门、地方执行和代表机构、准公共部门组织和其他组织。
负责领导州政府、州预算委员会、吸引投资者和改善投资环境委员会、州协调委员会，以及其他由官方页面列明的州级协调机构。
地区行政长官办公室的责任机构和职位：国家秘密保护处、地区行政长官新闻处、内部审计处、地区行政长官政权助理、地区行政长官军事安全和国防助理。

people.generalInfoHtml: born in 1971, a native of the Akmola region. He graduated from Moscow State University named after M. V. Lomonosov (economist), Karaganda State University named after E. A. Buketov (lawyer).
people.careerHistoryHtml:
In 1994-2004, he worked in responsible positions in various commercial structures.

In 2004-2006, he held the positions of Deputy Director of the Department of Economics and Finance, Chief of Staff of the Ministry of Culture, Information and Sports of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

In 2007-2009 he was the Deputy Chairman of the Board of "JSC "NC SEC "Zhetisu". In 2009-2019, he worked as Deputy General Director of the Financial and Industrial Corporation "Berkut", Deputy Chairman of the Board of the National Economic Chamber of Kazakhstan "Union" Atameken ", Chief of Staff, Deputy Chairman of the Board of the National Chamber of Entrepreneurs of the Republic of Kazakhstan "Atameken".

In 2019-2020, he served as Vice Minister of Culture and Sports of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

In 2021-2023, he worked as deputy akim of the Akmola region.

Implementation of the national project "Strong regions-driver of the country's development", the national project for the development of the agro-industrial complex of the Republic of Kazakhstan for 2021 - 2025, the national project "Safe country", the national project "Green Kazakhstan", the Concept for the development of housing and communal infrastructure until 2026, A comprehensive plan for the socio-economic development of settlements adjacent to the city of Nur-Sultan until 2023, the Concept of the Anti-Corruption Policy of the Republic of Kazakhstan for 2022-2026.

Since May 2023 He has been working as the first deputy akim of Akmola region.

 

First Deputy Akim of the Region for Housing and Utilities and Infrastructure Development

Implementation of the national project "Safe Country", the Concept for the Development of Housing and Public Utilities Infrastructure until 2026, the Comprehensive Development Plan for the Astana Agglomeration for 2024-2028, the Concept of the Anti-Corruption Policy of the Republic of Kazakhstan for 2022-2026.

Control over supervised areas:

for the execution of instructions of the Head of State, the Administration of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Office of the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Akim and the Akimat of the region;

for assessing the effectiveness of the activities of state bodies carried out both at the republican and regional levels;

for the implementation of the Development Plan of the Akmola Region for 2021-2025.

Interacts:

at the republican level: with the Administration of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Government Office of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Parliament of the Republic of Kazakhstan, ministries

and other central government bodies;

at the regional level: with law enforcement and special government bodies, territorial departments of central government bodies, local executive and representative bodies, quasi-public sector organizations and other organizations on supervised issues.

Coordinates: the Department of Construction, Architecture and Urban Development of the Akmola Region, the Department of Passenger Transport and Highways of the Akmola Region, the Department of Energy and Housing and Public Utilities of the Akmola Region, the Department of State Architectural and Construction Control of the Akmola Region, the Department of Mobilization Preparation, Territorial and Civil Defense of the Akmola Region, the State Institution "Department of Mobilization Preparation and Territorial Defense of the Akmola Region", the Department of Mobilization Preparation of the Akim's Office of the Region, the Department of State and Legal Work of the Akim's Office of the Region (in terms of combating corruption and working with law enforcement agencies), chief inspectors and chief specialists in housing and public utilities and infrastructure development of the Akim's Office of the Region.

Heads: the commission for reviewing tender proposals, evaluating them and determining the winners of the competition for the right to service regular intercity, interregional, interdistrict (intercity intraregional) automobile transportation routes for passengers and baggage, the commission on tariffs for interdistrict intraregional communications, the commission for conducting direct negotiations to determine private partners for public-private partnership projects in the field of passenger transport, the interdepartmental commission on equity participation in housing construction in the Akmola region, the commission for the formation of consolidated applications for the supply of liquefied petroleum gas, the regional draft commission, the tender commission, the commission for determining private partners for public-private partnership projects (in supervised areas).

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 1994年至2004年，他在多个商业机构担任负责职务。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: In 1994-2004, he worked in responsible positions in various commercial structures.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 2004年至2006年，任哈萨克斯坦共和国文化、信息和体育部经济财政司副司长、办公厅主任。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: In 2004-2006, he held the positions of Deputy Director of the Department of Economics and Finance, Chief of Staff of the Ministry of Culture, Information and Sports of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 2007-2009 年，他担任“JSC”NC SEC“Zhetisu”董事会副主席。 2009年至2019年，担任“Berkut”金融工业公司副总经理、哈萨克斯坦“联盟”阿塔梅肯国家经济商会董事会副主席、哈萨克斯坦共和国“阿塔梅肯”国家企业家商会幕僚长、董事会副主席。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: In 2007-2009 he was the Deputy Chairman of the Board of " JSC " NC SEC " Zhetisu " . In 2009-2019, he worked as Deputy General Director of the Financial and Industrial Corporation "Berkut", Deputy Chairman of the Board of the National Economic Chamber of Kazakhstan "Union" Atameken ", Chief of Staff, Deputy Chairman of the Board of the National Chamber of Entrepreneurs of the Republic of Kazakhstan "Atameken".

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 2019-2020年，担任哈萨克斯坦共和国文化体育部副部长。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: In 2019-2020, he served as Vice Minister of Culture and Sports of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 2021年至2023年，担任阿克莫拉州副州长。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: In 2021-2023, he worked as deputy akim of the Akmola region.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 实施“强大地区——国家发展的驱动力”国家项目、2021-2025年哈萨克斯坦共和国农工综合体发展国家项目、“安全国家”国家项目、“绿色哈萨克斯坦”国家项目、到2026年住房和公共基础设施发展概念、努尔苏丹市周边居民点社会经济发展综合计划到2023年，哈萨克斯坦共和国2022-2026年反腐败政策构想。

people.name: Zharkeshov Ernar Serikbayevich
people.workScopeZh: 工业和商业
people.generalInfoHtml: Yernar Serikbayevich Zharkeshov, born in 1986, is a native of the Ulytau Region. He graduated from the University of Birmingham (UK) with a Bachelor of Science in Public Policy, Management and Governance; the Kazakh University of Economics, Finance and International Trade with a Bachelor’s degree in Finance; the Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy at the National University of Singapore with a Master of Science in Public Policy; and the John F. Kennedy School of Government at Harvard University with a Master of Public Administration.
people.careerHistoryHtml:
From June to August 2008, he worked as an intern at the Administration of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, in the Department of State Control and Organizational and Personnel Work.

From 2010 to 2011, he worked as a Research Assistant at the Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy at the National University of Singapore.

From 2011 to 2012, he served as Chief Expert at JSC “Institute of Economic Research” and JSC “Kazakhstan Center for Public-Private Partnership” under the Ministry of Economic Development of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

From 2012 to 2014, he held the positions of Deputy Director, Acting Director, and Director of the Research Institute of the Academy of Public Administration under the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

From 2014 to 2017, he worked as a National Consultant, Project Manager, and Head of Project Portfolio at the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) in Kazakhstan.

From 2017 to 2019, he served as Executive Director, CEO, and Managing Partner of Center for Strategic Initiatives LLP, a private Kazakh consulting company.

From 2019 to 2021, he worked as Director for Eurasia at the international consulting company Whiteshield Partners, Dubai, UAE.

From 2021 to 2024, he was a member of the Board of Directors of the Asian Association for Public Administration, Seoul, South Korea       (remote position).

From 2022 to 2023, he served as a member of the Board of Directors of Samruk-Energo JSC.

From 2022 to 2024, he worked as Managing Director of the private company AQ Management and Polistrogroup LLP.

From February to June 2024, he served as a Freelance Adviser to the Chairman of the Senate of the Parliament of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

Responsibilities:

- ensuring the timely, high-quality, and comprehensive implementation of state policy and regional programs in the fields of economics, budget planning, finance, public procurement, management of коммунal property and housing stock, entrepreneurship, tourism, investment, and industrial and innovative development in the Akmola Region;

- ensuring the timely, high-quality, and comprehensive execution of acts and instructions issued by the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Prime Minister, the Presidential Administration, the State Adviser, the Office of the Government, as well as acts and instructions of the Akim and Akimat of the Akmola Region;

- ensuring interaction with the Administration of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Office of the Government, central state bodies and their territorial divisions, as well as other state bodies and institutions.

Organizes:

- the development of the draft regional budget and timely, high-quality planning aimed at the effective implementation of socio-economic development priorities;

- budget planning and execution activities;

- management of communal property and housing stock;

- activities related to the development of entrepreneurship, domestic trade, tourism, investment attraction, and the implementation of industrial and innovative projects;

- public procurement activities, including interaction with authorized bodies, the single public procurement operator, and state audit and financial control authorities.

Coordinates:

- interaction among territorial bodies in implementing programs and comprehensive measures in the areas of economics, budget planning, finance, public procurement, communal property and housing management, entrepreneurship, tourism, investment, and industrial and innovative development;

- cooperation between quasi-public sector organizations, business entities, international and public organizations, foundations, and other enterprises within the scope of assigned powers;

- interaction with branches of financial development institutions and second-tier banks to support the development of small and medium-sized businesses in the region.

Provides guidance to:

-  structural divisions of the Akimat responsible for economics, budget planning, finance, public procurement, communal property and housing management, entrepreneurship, tourism, investment, and industrial and innovative development.

He also heads territorial advisory and coordinating councils and commissions within the scope of his assigned powers.
